name: VB2
summary:
VB2 is a wheeled humanoid from VMR (Weimaier), a wholly owned subsidiary of Lanxin Robotics. It combines seven-joint arms, five-finger hands and an omnidirectional wheeled base for indoor mobile manipulation. The manufacturer specifies a 0.2–2 m working-height range, 5 kg load per arm and 760 mm arm reach.

SLAM navigation, panoramic RGB-D perception and autonomous obstacle avoidance support movement through workspaces. VMR lists four to six hours of runtime and a maximum base speed of 1.2 m/s. These are manufacturer specifications; task duration depends on operating conditions.
